title: California homeless woman details escape from fallen tree: ‘They cut the tent open’
description: A homeless woman in Sacramento has described her escape from a fallen tree. Ruby Stonebraker, 73, said she and her dog were trapped in their tent after a tree fell on it during a windstorm. “My dog was between my legs and the tree was on me, I couldn’t get out,” Ms Stonebraker explained. She explained that nearby neighbours had to “cut the tent open” to get her out. “I don’t know if I got hurt by it or not, because of my age,” she added, surveying the damage caused by the falling tree.

This piece describes my experience attending our downtown campus during the last four years of rising homelessness on the sidewalks. It ends with a request for broad homeless policy priority changes in the context of our mayoral race.
author: Aidan Roland
